name: What are the biggest mistakes in open-floor-plan conversions?

mainEntity.name: What are the most common mistakes people make during an open-floor-plan conversion?
mainEntity.text: What are the most common mistakes people make during an open-floor-plan conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common errors happen when homeowners focus only on taking walls down. That can leave them with a room that looks bigger but functions worse. Other mistakes include skipping structural verification, underbidding the project, ignoring utility relocation, and forgetting how furniture will fit once the old rooms disappear. Open spaces also need attention to lighting, acoustics, and traffic flow. In Los Angeles remodels, another frequent problem is waiting too long to check permit and inspection requirements. The best way to avoid these issues is to design the new space first, confirm structure and utilities second, and only then finalize the construction scope. A good remodel should improve both appearance and daily use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common mistakes include removing too much storage, underestimating structural costs, ignoring HVAC and electrical changes, and failing to plan furniture layout before demolition.
